name: Haiboku Yuusha -Seikishi Ouji Alec Hen-
original_name: 敗北勇者 ー聖騎士王子アレク編ー
source:
A group of heroes bust into the base of the Demon Lord
who threatens to annihilate the world.

However, they are utterly defeated by his overwhelming dark power...

As he lies dying, the hero finds himself subjected to the Demon Lord's wicked humiliations.
What awaits at the end of his ordeal? Will it be a reversal, sexual corruption, or something else...?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ01364270.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一群英雄闯入魔王的基地
谁威胁要毁灭世界。

然而，他们却被他那压倒性的黑暗力量彻底击败了……

当英雄躺在地上濒临死亡时，他发现自己遭受了恶魔领主的邪恶羞辱。
在他的磨难结束时等待着他的是什么？会是反转、性腐败，还是别的什么……？
